concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 3 (T012, T013, T014a, T014b, T015, T016)
concerns.text: User Story 1 (Data Ingestion) is incomplete. Tasks T012 (Filtering), T013 (Imputation), T014a/b (DQS), T015 (Save), and T016 (Error Handling) are marked as unchecked `[ ]`. Without these, the system cannot load, filter, or impute data as required by FR-001, FR-007, and FR-008. The 'Independent Test' for US-1 cannot be executed.

User Story 2 (Correlation/Regression) is incomplete. Tasks T026 (Save Correlation Results) and T027 (Save Regression Results) are unchecked `[ ]`. T025b (Residual Validation) is also unchecked. These are required to produce the artifacts for SC-001 and SC-002. The 'Independent Test' for US-2 cannot verify output CSVs if they are not saved.

User Story 3 (Correction/Visualization) is incomplete. Tasks T032 (FDR), T033 (Save Q-values), T034-T036 (Plots), T037 (Edge Case Labeling), T038 (Validation), and T039 (Completeness) are all unchecked `[ ]`. This leaves FR-005, FR-006, and SC-003/SC-004 unimplemented. The pipeline cannot generate the required plots or corrected p-values.

Polish & Cross-Cutting Concerns are incomplete. T040 (Orchestration), T041 (README), T042 (CI Tests), T043 (Schema Verification), and T044 (Quickstart) are unchecked `[ ]`. T040 is critical for running the pipeline end-to-end; without it, the project is not reproducible (violating Constitution Principle I).

Spec Override tasks T045, T046, and T047 are marked `[X]` (complete), but the `spec.md` file itself remains unchanged (as noted in the Analyze Report). While the tasks exist to document the rejection, the 'stale tags' concern applies here: the tasks reference rejecting FR-003/FR-007/SC-001, but the spec still mandates them. This creates a traceability gap where the canonical spec contradicts the implementation plan. The tasks should ideally include a step to 'Update spec.md' or the spec should be amended to reflect the plan's corrections.
